cockpit_asset_unavailable.title: Game cockpit frontend is unavailable
cockpit_asset_unavailable.description: The {profile_id} game profile loaded, but its cockpit frontend failed validation ({error_type}). Basic Nitrado management remains available. Repair or update the integration/profile package, then reload the integration.

missing_service.title: Nitrado service is missing
missing_service.description: {service_name} is no longer visible in the Nitrado account service list. If this is expected, remove the service from the integration. If Nitrado brings it back with the same service ID, this issue will clear automatically.

profile_option.title: Configure {option_name}

data.confirm: I understand and confirm this decision

error.repair_failed: The profile setting could not be saved. Reload Repairs and try again.

ftp_plaintext_consent_required.title: Secure Nitrado file transport is unavailable
ftp_plaintext_consent_required.description: {service_name} could not establish secure FTPS repeatedly. Plaintext FTP remains blocked. Review the advanced transport warning before deciding whether to permit plaintext FTP for service {service_id}.

ftp_credentials_unavailable.title: Nitrado file credentials are unavailable
ftp_credentials_unavailable.description: {service_name} repeatedly failed to obtain or authenticate its Nitrado FTP credentials. Advanced file operations remain unavailable for service {service_id}; ordinary server monitoring and controls are unaffected.

ftp_transport_unavailable.title: Nitrado file transport is unavailable
ftp_transport_unavailable.description: {service_name} repeatedly failed to establish the requested Nitrado file transport. Advanced file operations remain unavailable for service {service_id}; ordinary server monitoring and controls are unaffected.

confirm.title: Retry verified file recovery
confirm.description: Service {service_id} has an unfinished {operation} transaction ({transaction_id}) in state {state}. File changes and server Start are blocked until recovery is verified. The server must be stopped. Home Assistant will restore the exact pre-mutation content and verify it before clearing this issue. Select **Submit** to retry recovery.

error.repair_failed: Recovery did not complete. Check the server state and logs, then try again.

confirm.title: Acknowledge unverified file state
confirm.description: Service {service_id} transaction {transaction_id} cannot be recovered automatically because its private recovery data is missing. Do not start or change the server until the files are inspected manually. Only continue after manually inspecting the provider files. This archives the incident as **acknowledged, not verified**; it does not claim recovery succeeded. Select **Submit** to acknowledge it.

error.repair_failed: The incident could not be acknowledged. Reload Repairs and try again.

confirm.title: Acknowledge unverified file state
confirm.description: Service {service_id} transaction {transaction_id} has recovery data that failed its integrity check. Do not start or change the server until the files are inspected manually. Only continue after manually inspecting the provider files. This archives the incident as **acknowledged, not verified**; it does not claim recovery succeeded. Select **Submit** to acknowledge it.

error.repair_failed: The incident could not be acknowledged. Reload Repairs and try again.

filesystem_journal_corrupt.title: Nitrado file recovery journal is corrupt
filesystem_journal_corrupt.description: The durable provider-file journal could not be verified. File changes and server Start are blocked until the journal and remote files are inspected.

provider_grant_store_corrupt.title: Nitrado companion access grants are corrupt
provider_grant_store_corrupt.description: The persistent provider-connector grant store could not be verified. All companion integration access is denied until an administrator repairs or recreates the grants.

native_backup_restore_review_required.title: Nitrado native backup restore needs review

confirm.title: Acknowledge unverified native restore
confirm.description: Native restore {operation_id} for service {service_id}, folder {folder}, backup {backup_id} is in state {state} ({failure_code}). Nitrado may have accepted the restore, but a complete provider restore transition was not proven. Inspect the provider and server before taking further recovery action. Only continue after inspecting Nitrado and the game server. This closes the incident as **acknowledged, unverified**; it does not claim the restore or game health succeeded. Select **Submit** to acknowledge it.

error.repair_failed: The native restore incident could not be acknowledged. Reload Repairs and try again.

native_backup_journal_corrupt.title: Nitrado native backup restore journal is corrupt

confirm.title: Quarantine corrupt restore history
confirm.description: The durable native-backup restore journal could not be verified. Native restores are blocked until the journal and provider state are inspected. Only continue after inspecting Nitrado and the game server. Home Assistant will preserve the rejected journal in quarantine before resetting active restore tracking. No restore will be marked successful. Select **Submit** to quarantine and reset.

error.repair_failed: The corrupt journal could not be safely quarantined and reset.
